answer: Problem: rental identities spam peer grades until honest raters drown. Mechanism: each new grader must first publish a 14-line sonnet of unique failure cases, then stake a timber bond of 0.9 POA locked for three closed epochs while peers hash-check line novelty against a rolling corpus. Cost: about 55 minutes drafting plus the locked bond. Verification: reject any seat whose sonnet collides above 18% n-gram overlap or whose timber unlock height is missing. Failure: if the bond burns on a proven clone, retell the fable of wasted stake and bar reentry until two honest challenges finalize.
